## Overview Extend the Gemma 4 KV-sharing fast prefill support introduced in [#38879](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/38879) to work with Gemma 4 MTP on Model Runner V2. This PR narrows the compatibility guard, reuses the existing execution path, and adds an A/B regression test for output agreement and speculative acceptance. ## Claims - Add a narrow exception for Gemma 4 MTP on MRV2, retaining the compatibility guard for other configurations. - Extend the fast-prefill compatibility guard to cover auxiliary hidden-state consumers such as `extract_hidden_states`. - Add a compiled, chunked-prefill A/B regression test that compares output text and first-position speculative acceptance with fast prefill enabled and disabled. - Document the combined configuration. Fast prefill remains opt-in. ## Validation The revised regression test was validated locally at commit `7815aea3bd44323dc4d91c78a432fa3c9e105ad5` using an RTX 3090, Gemma 4 E2B IT and its assistant, TP=1, MRV2, and `TRITON_ATTN`. Earlier latency and GSM8K measurements below were collected at `7b1d07440dde8426a8b3d85e5f5815c06913eb82`. ### Regression Tests The revised compiled MRV2 A/B regression test passed locally (`1 passed`, RTX 3090, E2B, TRITON_ATTN): 99/101 outputs matched exactly (required:81/101), and first-position acceptance was 55.51% with fast prefill off versus 55.29% on (required: ≥90% of baseline). Batch invariance was disabled.
Regression command ```bash CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=1 VLLM_USE_V2_MODEL_RUNNER=1 \ VLLM_MODEL_REDIRECT_PATH=/home/lzc/fast-prefill-mtp-20261023/model_redirect.json \ .venv/bin/python -m pytest \ tests/v1/e2e/spec_decode/mtp/gemma4/test_mtp.py -k fast_prefill -x -v -s ``` The redirect file maps the target and assistant model IDs to local checkpoint copies.
### Exploratory latency measurement 8,192 input tokens, 64 output tokens, MTP=1. | Metric | Fast prefill off | Fast prefill on | | --- | --- | --- | | Mean TTFT | 1018.15 ms | 695.39 ms (-31.70%) | | TTFT standard deviation | 6.37 ms | 7.67 ms | | Mean TPOT | 5.407 ms | 5.386 ms | Configuration: synthetic repeated-sentence input, concurrency 1, MBT=512, 4 GiB KV, prefix caching disabled, 3 warmups and 20 measured requests per arm. Another user's process shared the GPU during this single sequential A/B run; the result is not an exclusive-GPU or repeated interleaved speedup estimate. ### GSM8K evaluation lm_eval 0.4.12, all 1,319 questions, 5-shot multi-turn few-shot, thinking disabled, greedy decoding, 1,024-token output limit, concurrency 16, harness/API seed 42, MTP depth 1, and no response caching. The standard task and scoring filters were unchanged. Servers used `--generation-config vllm`; A/B differed only by `--kv-sharing-fast-prefill`. Run | Strict-match (primary) | Flexible-extract | Length-truncated requests | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | A: fast prefill off | 743/1319 (56.33%) | 1090/1319 (82.64%) | 16 | | B: fast prefill on | 729/1319 (55.27%) | 1083/1319 (82.11%) | 22 | | A2: baseline repeated | 735/1319 (55.72%) | 1075/1319 (81.50%) | 16 B's strict-match score was **1.0614 percentage points lower than A's**, and the repeated baseline A2 also showed variation. The cause remains undetermined; these results establish neither losslessness nor a systematic quality regression caused by the optimization. All three runs completed **1,319 questions** with matching question and prompt hashes. Speculative drafting and acceptance occurred in every run, with no empty/null responses or unresolved request or parsing errors. ## Details Gemma 4's Q-only assistant reuses target KV and does not need skipped prompt rows to populate an independent draft KV cache. Non-shared target layers still populate prompt KV; trailing KV-sharing layers compute selected output and speculative-verification rows. This makes the existing fast-prefill path usable with Gemma 4 MTP on MRV2. The production change only narrows the configuration guard. Prompt logprobs remain unsupported. Local validation covers E2B on CUDA; other model sizes and backends were not tested locally. Open-PR searches on 2026-10-25 found related work on [V1 fast-prefill metadata (#60445)](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/60445), [Gemma 4 MTP compute (#60689)](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/60689), and [MTP draft-prefill attention pruning (#63195)](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/63195), but no matching PR enabling this MRV2 joint configuration. This change enables the existing target KV-sharing fast-prefill path with Gemma 4 MTP; it does not add draft-attention pruning or MTP kernels. AI assistance was used for implementation, source analysis, validation and this description. ---
Pull Request Checklist - [x] I used vLLM's `/pr-checklist` skill. (Mandatory for agents, optional for humans). - [x] AI assistance was used during the creation of this PR. - [x] **Design Fit:** Minimizes impact on core components, reuses existing functionality, and justifies added complexity. - [x] **Testing and Validation:** Validates the change and ensures any added tests are meaningful and reliable, with CI coverage or documented CI resource constraints and validation performed outside CI. - [x] **Code Quality and Style:** Keeps code and comments clear and concise, and updates relevant documentation and examples. - [x] **Pull Request Contents:** Includes a brief summary and relevant links, supports claims with evidence, explains root causes and implementation trade-offs, and follows the contributing guide.

The added test looks pretty heavy and does not check whether drafter has received the right hidden state. I'd suggest comparing acceptance rates in this test.

```suggestion
@single_gpu_only
def test_gemma4_mtp_fast_prefill(monkeypatch, vllm_runner):
    """Skipping prompt rows keeps target outputs and draft acceptance intact."""
    monkeypatch.setenv("VLLM_USE_V2_MODEL_RUNNER", "1")
    speculative_config = {
        "method": "mtp",
        "model": "google/gemma-4-E2B-it-assistant",
        "num_speculative_tokens": 2,
    }
    prompts = [
        "Calculate 17 times 23. Explain your calculation.",
        "Write a Python function that reverses a singly linked list.",
        "Background: "
        + "The cache stores keys and values. " * 200
        + "Explain why prefill can delay other requests.",
    ]
    results = []
    acceptance_rates = []
    for fast_prefill in [False, True]:
        with vllm_runner(
            "google/gemma-4-E2B-it",
            speculative_config=speculative_config,
            kv_sharing_fast_prefill=fast_prefill,
            language_model_only=True,
            attention_backend="TRITON_ATTN",
            max_model_len=4096,
            block_size=None,
            enable_chunked_prefill=True,
            max_num_batched_tokens=512,
            max_num_seqs=4,
            enable_prefix_caching=False,
            disable_log_stats=False,
            seed=42,
        ) as runner:
            tokenizer = runner.llm.get_tokenizer()
            formatted = [
                tokenizer.apply_chat_template(
                    [{"role": "user", "content": prompt}],
                    tokenize=False,
                    add_generation_prompt=True,
                )
                for prompt in prompts
            ]
            results.append(
                runner.generate_w_logprobs(
                    formatted,
                    SamplingParams(
                        temperature=0.0, max_tokens=64, ignore_eos=True, logprobs=5
                    ),
                )
            )
            acceptance_rates.append(compute_acceptance_rate(runner.llm.get_metrics()))
    check_logprobs_close(
        outputs_0_lst=results[0],
        outputs_1_lst=results[1],
        name_0="MTP",
        name_1="MTP with fast prefill",
    )
    assert acceptance_rates[1] == pytest.approx(acceptance_rates[0], abs=0.05)

files.patch:
@@ -35,6 +35,27 @@ for a Gemma 4 assistant checkpoint, that release is treating the assistant as a
 generic draft model and may fail during initialization for multimodal Gemma 4
 targets. Upgrade to a version with Gemma 4 MTP support instead.
 
+### KV-sharing fast prefill
+
+Combining Gemma 4 MTP with KV-sharing fast prefill requires Model Runner V2
+(`VLLM_USE_V2_MODEL_RUNNER=1`). For example, for Gemma 4 E2B:
+
+```bash
+VLLM_USE_V2_MODEL_RUNNER=1 vllm serve google/gemma-4-E2B-it \
+    --max-model-len 8192 \
+    --speculative-config '{"method":"mtp","model":"gg-hf-am/gemma-4-E2B-it-assistant","num_speculative_tokens":1}' \
+    --kv-sharing-fast-prefill
+```
+
+Fast prefill is opt-in and disabled by default. The target computes full prompt KV in its
+non-shared layers, while the trailing KV-sharing layers process only the
+positions needed for output logits and speculative verification.
+
+The Gemma 4 assistant reads the target KV cache, so it does not need complete
+prompt hidden states to build a separate draft KV cache. Other EAGLE-style
+speculators remain incompatible with this option. Prompt logprobs are not
+supported with fast prefill.
+
 ## Offline Example
 
 ```python

@@ -6,6 +6,7 @@
 from tests.utils import single_gpu_only
 from vllm import SamplingParams
 
+from ...utils import assert_request_outputs_match, get_test_prompts
 from .._correctness import check_mtp_correctness
 
 
@@ -37,3 +38,58 @@ def test_mtp_correctness(
         expected_accuracy_threshold,
         vllm_runner,
     )
+
+
+@single_gpu_only
+def test_gemma4_mtp_fast_prefill(
+    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch,
+    sampling_config: SamplingParams,
+    vllm_runner,
+):
+    """Skipping prompt rows keeps target outputs and draft acceptance intact."""
+    monkeypatch.setenv("VLLM_USE_V2_MODEL_RUNNER", "1")
+    speculative_config = {
+        "method": "mtp",
+        "model": "google/gemma-4-E2B-it-assistant",
+        "num_speculative_tokens": 2,
+    }
+    prompts = get_test_prompts(mm_enabled=False)
+    long_prompt = (
+        "Background: "
+        + "The cache stores keys and values. " * 200
+        + "Explain why prefill can delay other requests."
+    )
+    prompts.append([{"role": "user", "content": long_prompt}])
+    results = []
+    first_pos_acceptance_rates = []
+    for fast_prefill in [False, True]:
+        with vllm_runner(
+            "google/gemma-4-E2B-it",
+            speculative_config=speculative_config,
+            kv_sharing_fast_prefill=fast_prefill,
+            language_model_only=True,
+            attention_backend="TRITON_ATTN",
+            max_model_len=4096,
+            block_size=None,
+            enable_chunked_prefill=True,
+            max_num_batched_tokens=512,
+            enable_prefix_caching=False,
+            disable_log_stats=False,
+            seed=42,
+        ) as runner:
+            results.append(runner.llm.chat(prompts, sampling_config))
+            metrics = {m.name: m for m in runner.llm.get_metrics()}
+            first_pos_acceptance_rates.append(
+                metrics["vllm:spec_decode_num_accepted_tokens_per_pos"].values[0]
+                / metrics["vllm:spec_decode_num_drafts"].value
+            )
+    assert_request_outputs_match(
+        results[0],
+        results[1],
+        required_matches=int(0.8 * len(results[0])) + 1,

            formatted = [
